---
title: "Step 3 — Send us your check result"
subtitle: "Step 3 of 5"
---

**Time:** 2 minutes.
**Before you start:** [Step 2](check-setup.qmd) finished, with the check output
copied.
**When you finish:** we know whether your laptop is ready, and we have time to
fix it if it is not.

Send this whether it passed or failed.

## Step 1 of 3 — Write the email

1. Open your email program.
2. Address it to
   [office.msicph@iisc.ac.in](mailto:office.msicph@iisc.ac.in).
3. Type this subject line, with your own name:
   `Epi course setup check — <your full name>`

**You should see:** a blank email with that subject line.

## Step 2 of 3 — Paste the output

1. Click inside the body of the email.
2. Paste the check output you copied in Step 2.
3. Above the pasted text, type your operating system and its version, for
   example `Windows 11 23H2` or `macOS 15.3 on an M2`.
4. On the next line, type whether you have administrator rights on that laptop.

**You should see:** the full check output as plain text in the email body.

**If it does not work:** paste text, not a screenshot. A picture of an error
cannot be searched, cannot be pasted back to you as a fix, and is usually
cropped one line above the line that mattered.

## Step 3 of 3 — Send it

1. Read the subject line once more. Your name must be in it.
2. Press **Send**.

**You should see:** the email in your Sent folder.

**If it does not work:** if the email bounces, send the same text on the course
WhatsApp group instead: [TBD: WhatsApp group link]{.tbd}.

## Template

Copy this, fill it in, send it.

```
Subject: Epi course setup check — Priya Sharma

Name: Priya Sharma
Operating system: Windows 11 23H2
Administrator rights: yes

--- check_setup.R output below ---

<paste the whole console output here>
```

::: {.callout-note}
## Why this matters
A passing report takes us 10 seconds to file. A failing report takes us a day to
fix, and we would rather have that day than have you sitting in the room on
Monday with a laptop that does not work.

We ask for your operating system because most install failures are
platform-specific. We ask about administrator rights because that is the fix
we cannot apply for you.
:::
